headline: OpenAI has received roughly $11 billion of a round valuing it at $1.25 trillion
body: Bloomberg reports the money was wired on Friday. The $11 billion is the first tranche, and The Decoder says the full round could grow to $20 billion. OpenAI had originally sought $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation but scaled back after an AI-sector selloff.
note: The round is smaller than the $30 billion OpenAI originally sought, after an AI-sector selloff.

evidence.text: The money was wired on Friday, Bloomberg reports.
OpenAI has received roughly $11 billion in new funding, the first tranche of a round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion.
The full round could grow to $20 billion, with the rest expected in the coming weeks.
OpenAI originally sought $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation but scaled back after an AI-sector selloff.
